messages:
Maria T.: quick idea — add a light "compat heuristic" step in model-onboard to short-circuit heavy runtime checks for known-good quant artifacts. propose: run cheap fingerprints + perf heuristics first, only run full runtime on failure. motivation: reduce eval pipeline cost for frequent small updates. cc @kevin_l and @sara

Kevin L.: sounds reasonable. what's the failure mode? false negatives leading to bad runtime incompatibility?

Maria T.: yes. tradeoff is higher false negative rate. plan: heuristic passes -> onboard flagged as "fast-pass" and scheduled for nightly full runtime validation. If heuristic fails -> normal heavy validation immediately.

Sara P.: how do we define fingerprints? is this the same as the binary signature we already store?

Anil R.: we can reuse sha256 of model bytes + metadata hash + a small shape / dtype vector. cheap.

Maria T.: example pseudo-output:
```
{ "fingerprint": "sha256:abcd...", "arch": "llama2", "dtype_vector": "fp16->int8?", "fast_pass": true }
```

Kevin L.: perf heuristics: check kv-cache size estimate + kv-keys alignment + first-token perf on cpus. If perf delta < 10% -> pass.

Sara P.: what's the interface? I suggest a single protobuf: OnboardCheckResult { fingerprint, heuristics_pass, reasons[] }

Anil R.: keep it language-agnostic; existing grpc endpoint /onboard/quick-check should return that proto.

Maria T.: rollout: guarded behind FF `onboard.fast_heuristics_v1`, default off. start with private-dedicated models then expand.

Ingest-bot: deploy: quick-check-service v0.1 -> 10% traffic -> 2026-03-12T16:05Z

Kevin L.: metrics we will track: `onboard.quick_pass_rate`, `onboard.postvalidation_fail_rate`, `onboard.eval_cost_saved_tokens`.

Sara P.: alert if postvalidation_fail_rate > 0.5% for 24h.

Dana M.: can we store a "fast-pass" tag in registry so runtime routing can prefer quant-friendly kernels?

Anil R.: yes, adds tiny shim in model-metadata. we'll add `compat.fast_pass: true/false`. Need DB migration? minimal — add nullable field.

Maria T.: open questions: how to handle models that change but keep same fingerprint? need epoch-based fingerprinting.

Kevin L.: follow-ups: PR for proto, RFC doc link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/fast-heuristics, owners: @maria_t, @anil_r. I'll schedule a 30m sync Fri

Maria T.: thanks. action items: 1) Anil proto PR, 2) Kevin infra rollout plan, 3) Sara add alerts/dashboards, 4) Dana registry tag PR. assign and update thread with links.

Kevin L.: noted. :thumbsup: 

Maria T.: bumping — we agreed on FF flow; started on proto in https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboard/pull/312

Sara P.: added grafana panels and alert, PTAL: https://grafana.redwood/influx/onboard

Dana M.: registry PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/registry/pull/78

Anil R.: proto merged, CI green. will deploy canary today.

Maria T.: nice, closing sync. will post postmortem if we see regressions.
